info.name: APM Availability Monitoring Apm Synthetic API
apmSynthetic
List dedicated vantage points specified in an APM domain.

params.name: apmDomainId
params.description: The APM domain ID the request is intended for.

params.name: limit
params.description: The maximum number of items to return.

params.name: page
params.description:
The maximum number of results per page, or items to return in a paginated
"List" call. For information on how pagination works, see
[List Pagination](/iaas/Content/API/Concepts/usingapi.htm#nine).

Example: `50`

params.name: sortOrder
params.description: The sort order to use, either ascending (`ASC`) or descending (`DESC`). Default sort order is ascending.

params.name: sortBy
params.description:
The field to sort by. Only one sort order may be provided.
Default order of displayName is ascending.
Default order of timeCreated and timeUpdated is descending.
The displayName sort by is case-sensitive.

params.name: displayName
params.description: A filter to return only the resources that match the entire display name.

params.name: name
params.description: A filter to return only the resources that match the entire name.

params.name: status
params.description: A filter to return only the dedicated vantage points that match a given status.

items.docs: Returns a list of dedicated vantage points.

info.name: List monitors specified in an APM domain.

params.name: apmDomainId
params.description: The APM domain ID the request is intended for.

params.name: displayName
params.description: A filter to return only the resources that match the entire display name.

params.name: scriptId
params.description: A filter to return only monitors using scriptId.

params.name: vantagePoint
params.description: The name of the public or dedicated vantage point.

params.name: monitorType
params.description:
A filter to return only monitors that match the given monitor type.
Supported values are SCRIPTED_BROWSER, BROWSER, SCRIPTED_REST, REST, NETWORK, DNS, FTP and SQL.

params.name: status
params.description: A filter to return only monitors that match the status given.

params.name: limit
params.description: The maximum number of items to return.

params.name: page
params.description:
The maximum number of results per page, or items to return in a paginated
"List" call. For information on how pagination works, see
[List Pagination](/iaas/Content/API/Concepts/usingapi.htm#nine).

Example: `50`

params.name: isMaintenanceWindowActive
params.description: A filter to return the monitors whose maintenance window is currently active.

params.name: isMaintenanceWindowSet
params.description: A filter to return the monitors whose maintenance window is set.

params.name: sortOrder
params.description: The sort order to use, either ascending (`ASC`) or descending (`DESC`). Default sort order is ascending.

params.name: sortBy
params.description:
The field to sort by. Only one sort order may be provided.
Default order of displayName is ascending.
Default order of timeCreated and timeUpdated is descending.
The displayName sort by is case insensitive.

items.docs: Returns a list of monitors.

info.name: Get monitor result(har, screenshot, log, network, diagnostics or script) identified by the execution time of the monitor identified by the OCID.

params.name: apmDomainId
params.description: The APM domain ID the request is intended for.

params.name: monitorId
params.description: The OCID of the monitor.

params.name: vantagePoint
params.description: The vantagePoint name.

params.name: resultType
params.description: The result type: har, screenshot, log, network, diagnostics or script.

params.name: resultContentType
params.description: The result content type: zip or raw.

params.name: executionTime
params.description: The time the object was posted.

items.docs: Gets the results for a specific execution of a monitor identified by OCID. The results are in a HAR file, Screenshot, Console Log, Network details, Diagnostics or Script Content.
